channel.title: GEIST · News
channel.description: News of the Human-Centered Information Systems group at TU Clausthal: announcements, awards, talks and events.

item.title: Keynote at Academic Mindtrek 2026
item.description: Kai Kunze gives the keynote "Augmenting Humans. From Physiology to Shared Experiences" at Academic Mindtrek 2026 in Tampere, Finland; the slides are online.

item.title: Doctoral Consortium at Academic Mindtrek 2026
item.description: Seven doctoral students presented their work at the Doctoral Consortium of Academic Mindtrek 2026 in Tampere; Kaisa Väänänen, Jasmin Niess, Jonna Häkkilä, Mila Bujić and Kai Kunze were the mentors.

item.title: Ceremonial lecture at the Golden Diploma 2026
item.description: Kai Kunze gave the ceremonial lecture "Der erweiterte Mensch" at TU Clausthal's golden diploma ceremony for the class of 1976, with a floating robot and a humanoid robot as guests.

item.title: Best Paper Award and Honorable Mention at ACM DIS 2026
item.description: At the ACM Designing Interactive Systems Conference 2026 in Singapore the chair received a Best Paper Award for Floating Companion and an Honorable Mention for a paper on collective digital art.

item.title: Kai Kunze appointed University Professor at TU Clausthal
item.description: Kai Kunze has been appointed University Professor of Human-Centered Information Systems at TU Clausthal; he has represented the subject at the Institut für Informatik since April 2026.

item.title: 3rd Place at TUniCorn 2026 – CLARA: AI-powered voice documentation for nursing care
item.description: Our team developed CLARA, an AI-based voice documentation solution for nursing care featuring offline capability, multilingualism and European AI, and has already trialled it in practice.

item.title: TU staff member develops a medical co-pilot
item.description: Dominik Schulz, research associate of the Human-Centered Information Systems group, took second place with Team AVAR at the HealthHack idea competition in Braunschweig.

item.title: Language-based care innovation impresses at hackathon – 2nd place for AV-AR
item.description: AV-AR (Actual Voice Augmented Reality), a prototype that analyses and documents care conversations live and proposes measures, took second place at the regional HealthHack 2025.

item.title: Augmenting Humans at the Neurolive Liveness Symposium
item.description: Kai Kunze was invited as a panelist to the three-day online Liveness Symposium of the Neurolive EU project, bringing together artists, humanities scholars and cognitive neuroscientists.

item.title: Augmented Humans 2020: taking a conference online
item.description: The co-organised Augmented Humans conference in Kaiserslautern moved to a fully virtual event because of COVID-19; Stelarc's keynote was pre-recorded and streamed.

item.title: Lessons from the Dagstuhl Seminar on Eyewear Computing
item.description: Why the Eyewear Computing seminar deviated from the standard Dagstuhl model: 3-minute talks, hands-on tutorials on eye tracking, egocentric vision, optics and head-mounted displays, and what worked.

item.title: ISWC and UbiComp in Heidelberg
item.description: Six GEIST papers at UbiComp/ISWC 2016 in Heidelberg, from a wearable ambient sound display to the Wordometer 2.0 and smooth-pursuit interaction with EOG glasses.

item.title: After ISWC/UbiComp 2015
item.description: Although officially founded on 24 September, GEIST had a strong presence at ISWC/UbiComp 2015; Vilhelmina Sokol won the Design Award at the ISWC Design Competition.

item.title: Introducing Geist
item.description: Kai Kunze announces GEIST, a new Real Project at Keio Media Design focused on understanding gut feeling and embodiment to augment intellect and skills using technology.
